narrative: 我大学选了历史专业，现在做图书管理员，月薪八千。
question: 如果当初我选的是计算机专业，现在收入会更高吗？

operationalization_hints.measurement: user's actual value is False; counterfactual asks value=True

ambiguities.description: This is a unit-level counterfactual (如果当初我...), not a population-average effect question. Pearl's Layer 3 (counterfactuals / twin network) is out of scope for the current kernel — only Layer 2 (interventional effect, P(Y|do(X))) is supported. Silently answering with an interventional effect confuses 'had the population done CS' with 'had I personally done CS'.
ambiguities.expected_behavior: declare extensions.ambiguities[kind=counterfactual_query] stating the kernel returns at best an interventional-effect proxy; the true counterfactual for THIS individual is out of scope. Query kind may still be effect, but the semantic gap must be named
